Welcome! This week focuses on how dynamical systems change as we change a parameter.

# In Class

## Systems to Explore

$\begin{align*}
\dot{x} &= r + x^2 \\
\dot{x} &= r - x^2 \\
\dot{x} &= rx - x^2 \\
\dot{x} &= rx - x^3 \\
\dot{x} &= -x + \beta \tanh(x) \\
\dot{x} &= rx + x^3 \\
\dot{x} &= rx + x^3 - x^5
\end{align*}$
